steps.name: DE test
steps.question: Which genes are DE between AD lesional and control?

plan.title: AD lesional vs control DE, ambiguous Salmon counts
plan.analytical_narrative: Two-group DE (6 AD lesional vs 6 control skin) on the delivered 12000-gene x 12-sample Salmon count matrix of unknown scaling, plus pathway context.

input.query: tximport salmon transcript quantification length correction differential expression DESeq2
tximport EST summation reassignment transcript-level quantification
tximport importing transcript-level quantifications into DESeq2 length correction gene-level differential expression

The one unresolved data issue is that the scaling of the Salmon matrix is explicitly unknown (raw unweighted, effective-length-corrected, or TPM) and cannot be re-derived, because the per-sample quant.sf directories were not delivered, so tximport is off the table. T2S1 turns that ranked list into pathway-level interpretation using local human gene sets (MSigDB hallmark and GO-BP 2026.1, WikiPathways human 2026.07.10), with the delivered ~12k genes as the ORA universe.
